$comment: The city's sign and ad library (docs/ADS-PLAN.md). Every sign belongs to a business (a tenant at a fixed floor) or a brand. tools/textures/build_signs.py renders each sign with Z-Image Turbo from one style template (`styles`), crops it to the sign, and packs the atlases in art/textures/signs/ with catalog.json. Seeds: `seed` + the sign's index unless `seeds` pins a pick (re-rolled because a take garbled its text). Rejected takes and why: `rejects`.
background: isolated on a plain pure black background, centered, the entire sign visible with black margin on all sides, straight-on front view, flat orthographic, photographed at night, no building, no street, no people, no other text

styles.lightbox: A single {shape} Japanese {trade} sign: a backlit acrylic lightbox glowing at night, {face} face with bold {ink} Japanese lettering (Japanese kanji and kana, not simplified Chinese) reading {text}{extra}, thin dark metal frame
styles.neon: A single {shape} Hong Kong {trade} neon sign: exposed glowing glass neon tubes forming the traditional Chinese characters {text} in {ink}{extra}, with a neon tube border in {border}, tubes mounted on a dark steel frame
styles.billboard: A single large Japanese {trade} advertising billboard: a backlit lightbox, the left half a bright photo of {photo}, the right half {face} with bold {ink} Japanese lettering reading {text} and below it a large floor number {floor}, thin dark metal frame
styles.brand: {art}, full-bleed advertising photograph filling the entire frame edge to edge, rich saturated colour, dramatic light, no text, no logo, no letters, no frame, no billboard, no border

$businesses: floor 1: street shops (fascia over the door + blade); floor >= 2: upper tenants (a panel in the building's tenant column + a blade at their floor, optional upper-wall billboard), the floor number is part of their signs. script ja: Japanese lightboxes; zh: Hong Kong neon (overhang + blade). Colours are words in the prompt; the runtime measures each sign's light colour.

businesses.icon: a red ramen bowl icon on the left
a coffee cup icon on the left

businesses.extra: , above them a neon bat holding a coin

$brands: International brands (English) for rooftops and towers: a text-free Z-Image photo plus a typeset wordmark (font, colour) composited by the builder. Rooftop/billboard boards use `land`, tower shafts and screens use `tall`. Crown lettering is the wordmark alone, as neon channel letters. jp: domestic brands with a Japanese wordmark (rooftops only).
